name: dsh-prompt-enhancer-pro
description: One-click prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness that runs on the model you already configured. No bundled third-party service, no outbound requests: your drafts never leave your own setup.

summary.en: One click in the composer rewrites your rough draft into a structured prompt, using the model you already configured. No bundled third-party channel and no outbound requests: your drafts never leave your own setup.
summary.zh: 输入框一键把草稿改写成结构化提示词，复用你已配置的模型。不内置第三方通道、不发起任何外部请求——你的提示词不会经过别人的服务器。
